note: Verifiable Intent shares AP2 v0.2 vct values with aligned constraint semantics and different key prefixes (payment.amount_range versus mandate.payment.amount_range); both were contributed to FIDO on 2026-04-28.

UCP embeds AP2 through the extension dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate (renamed in v2026-08-25): merchant signature in ap2.merchant_authorization, Checkout Mandate in ap2.checkout_mandate, Payment Mandate in the credential token. Live use unverified.
The a2a-x402 Embedded Flow nests x402 inside AP2 mandates, but it targets the v0.1 CartMandate and PaymentMandate; AP2 v0.2 has no Cart mandate. The AP2 repository ships x402 samples.
Indirect only: ERC-8004 lists A2A agent cards as services and AP2 can be implemented as an A2A extension. ERC-8226 is the closest on-chain analogue of an AP2 mandate.
The MPP payment discovery draft cites ERC-8004 and calls its off-chain discovery compatible with future on-chain anchoring; no integration is specified.

Neither depends on the other. ERC-8004 publishes x402Support, uses agentWallet as the payee address, and lets feedback files carry proofOfPayment for an x402 payment; Erik Reppel co-authors ERC-8004 and sits on the x402 TSC.
ACP has no mandates or signed user intent; AP2 mandates or Verifiable Intent could add that layer, but no adopted extension exists.
No documented protocol link. Stripe says it might use Mastercard Agent Pay tokens under SPT card payments.
Stripe co-maintains ACP and runs MPP; MPP accepts cards through the same Shared Payment Token family that implements ACP Delegate Payment.
Both define merchant-hosted agent checkout sessions; five status names match and both publish well-known discovery documents, but no bridge or mapping exists. Stripe supports both.
No documented protocol link. Stripe says it might use Visa Intelligent Commerce tokens under SPT card payments, so Visa agent tokens can sit under an ACP payment.

AP2 is an optional UCP extension, dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate (dev.ucp.shopping.ap2_mandate before v2026-08-25). UCP places the merchant authorization, checkout mandate and payment mandate; AP2 defines the formats. Live use is unverified.
Google launched both; Google donated AP2 to the FIDO Alliance on 2026-04-28 while UCP stays under its own Governing Council.

The network_token credential type (number, cryptogram, eci_value, token_requestor_id) can carry network tokens in general; no Agent Pay integration is documented, and Google surfaces use Google Pay PAN_ONLY.
Both specify agent checkout with the merchant as merchant of record; no bridge or mapping is specified. Stripe co-develops ACP and sits on UCP councils.
No documented relation in the spec; Stripe's UCP integration is a payment handler for tokenized methods, not MPP.
Both use RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures and UCP added optional Web Bot Auth interop; the UCP spec never names TAP and no bridge is documented. Visa is a listed endorser.

Same pattern on another network: RFC 9421 signatures with a network tag and a nonce, verified at the CDN. Mastercard uses one tag, Agent-pay-auth, and its own key directory, whose location is not public.
Visa says TAP complements ACP and Intelligent Commerce Connect accepts ACP payments; no wire-level binding is published.

Visa authored the MPP card method; draft-card-charge-00 lets a client add TAP signature headers, Visa says the card spec and mpp-card SDK are built on VIC and TAP, and mppx signs and verifies TAP attestations.
Intelligent Commerce Connect accepts UCP payments and Visa is listed as a UCP endorser; UCP has its own RFC 9421 signing, closer to the Web Bot Auth draft, and never names TAP.

TAP's browsingIOU answers an HTTP 402 with card-acquiring data but uses none of x402's headers or payloads; Visa is a Premier member of the x402 Foundation and said at launch it was working with Coinbase on interoperability.
AP2 can carry x402 as a payment method through the a2a-x402 extension launched on 2025-09-16; its embedded flow targets AP2 v0.1 mandates (CartMandate), which AP2 v0.2 no longer has.
ERC-8004 registration files carry an x402Support flag, feedback files can carry proofOfPayment for an x402 payment, and best practices use agentWallet as the x402 receipt address.
Mastercard is a Premier member of the x402 Foundation, which runs a card-acceptance working group; no technical link to Agent Pay was found.
MPP maps x402 exact onto its charge intent, and mppx can serve both protocols on one route; Stripe sits on the x402 TSC and co-created MPP.
Both offer HTTP 402 machine payments for agents; Visa and Artemis measured MPP far below x402 to 2026-04-21 (secondary report).

The TAP specification defines a browsingIOU object an agent sends when a merchant answered with 402; TAP samples use non-standard X-Payment headers rather than the x402 wire format. Visa is a Premier member of the x402 Foundation.
